statement: ∀ (bar : Reduction.loc p →+* K), letI : Algebra (Reduction.loc p) K := bar.toAlgebra; ∀ (Phi : Reduction.VK K M ≃ₗ[K] (K ⊗[Reduction.loc p] Reduction.MR p M)) (f : Module.End ℤ M), Phi.toLinearMap.comp (f.baseChange K) = ((f.baseChange (Reduction.loc p)).baseChange K).comp Phi.toLinearMap → ∀ (u w : Reduction.MR p M) (s : Reduction.loc p), f.baseChange (Reduction.loc p) u = s • w → f.baseChange K (Phi.symm (1 ⊗ₜ[Reduction.loc p] u)) = bar s • Phi.symm (1 ⊗ₜ[Reduction.loc p] w)
proof:
intro bar
letI : Algebra (Reduction.loc p) K := bar.toAlgebra
intro Phi f hf u w s hu
apply Phi.injective
have he := LinearMap.congr_fun hf (Phi.symm (1 ⊗ₜ[Reduction.loc p] u))
simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, LinearMap.baseChange_tmul, hu] at he
rw [he, Phi.map_smul, Phi.apply_symm_apply]
change (1 : K) ⊗ₜ[Reduction.loc p] (s • w) = bar s • ((1 : K) ⊗ₜ[Reduction.loc p] w)
rw [TensorProduct.tmul_smul]
rfl

checked : ∀ (p : ℕ) (l : ℤ) (K : Type u_2) [fieldK : Field K] (V : Type u_1) [addV : AddCommGroup V]
  [modV : _root_.Module ℂ V] (act : ↥Reduction.SL →ₗ⁅ℂ⁆ End ℂ V) (x y h : ↥Reduction.SL) (v0 : V) (M : Submodule ℤ V),
  Nat.Prime p →
    CharP K p →
      0 ≤ l ∧ l < ↑p →
        Reduction.chevalley x y h →
          Reduction.basisFacts l (act x) (act y) (act h) v0 →
            Reduction.localizationFacts p l (act x) (act y) (act h) v0 M →
              Reduction.commonFacts p l (act y) v0 M →
                Reduction.scalarFacts p K M →
                  ∀ (bar : ↥(Reduction.loc p) →+* K)
                    (Phi : Reduction.VK K M ≃ₗ[K] K ⊗[↥(Reduction.loc p)] Reduction.MR p M) (f : End ℤ ↥M),
                    ↑Phi ∘ₗ LinearMap.baseChange K f =
                        LinearMap.baseChange K (LinearMap.baseChange (↥(Reduction.loc p)) f) ∘ₗ ↑Phi →
                      ∀ (u w : Reduction.MR p M) (s : ↥(Reduction.loc p)),
                        (LinearMap.baseChange (↥(Reduction.loc p)) f) u = s • w →
                          (LinearMap.baseChange K f) (Phi.symm (1 ⊗ₜ[↥(Reduction.loc p)] u)) =
                            bar s • Phi.symm (1 ⊗ₜ[↥(Reduction.loc p)] w)
